annotations.title: Dismiss an open incident as noise

description: Wraps POST /api/incidents/{id}/dismiss. Dismiss an open incident as noise. Hides it from the open lists for the whole team; it never alerts again and closes without a message. Not every kind can be dismissed (409). It acts for the whole team. Needs a Member or Admin key, on a team with 10 sites or more.
name: incidents_by_id_dismiss
